about_the_game:
Race against your friends in one massive sprawling platformer level created by you and your friends!

First everyone is given a time limit to create and beat a small level. Then all levels that make it through are stitched together with checkpoints along the way. Then choose your game mode and run for glory! Use traps and blocks with special properties to make your level however you want, whether that's tough as nails platforming or a satisfying parkour challenge. Decide on a theme to really bring out the atmosphere and mood.

Though mostly focused on multiplayer, you can create your own levels offline in a solo level editor and share them online. The possibilities are near endless.

Cool Features-


Online multiplayer for lobbies of all sizes
Modifiers that twist the game on its head
Play and share custom levels online
Dozens of unique traps and blocks
Precise and engaging platforming
An intuitive level editor
Hats, lots of hats
